```lean
theorem lg_target {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] {X Y : C} {f : X ⟶ Y} {c : CategoryTheory.Limits.PullbackCone f f} (hc : CategoryTheory.Limits.IsLimit c) : CategoryTheory.Mono f ↔ CategoryTheory.IsIso c.snd := by
  constructor
  · intro h_mono
    have h_mono' : CategoryTheory.IsMono f := h_mono
    exact CategoryTheory.Limits.isIsoOfIsLimit hc (CategoryTheory.Limits.isMonoOfIsLimit hc h_mono')
  · intro h_iso
    have h_iso' : CategoryTheory.IsIso c.snd := h_iso
    exact CategoryTheory.Limits.isMonoOfIsLimit hc h_iso'
```
